payout_quote: Referrer is eligible to receive a $100 Reward for each Referred Individual who completes all Qualifying Activities for Qualifying Consumer or Business Checking Accounts opened on or after 3/1/2026 during the Program Period.
steps: Be a First Financial Bank customer
Register a referral for a new individual to open a qualifying consumer or business checking account
The referred individual completes all qualifying activities for the account
You receive a $100 Reward per referral (for accounts opened on or after 3/1/2026); $50 for accounts opened before 3/1/2026
catches: Cap: participants can receive up to $500 per calendar year in Rewards (referrer, referred, or both)
$100 referrer reward only for qualifying accounts opened on or after 3/1/2026; $50 for accounts opened before 3/1/2026
Only one referrer can receive a reward per referred individual (first referral registration wins)
Referred individuals get their own reward: $150 for business checking, $100 for consumer checking (accounts opened on/after 3/1/26)
Pending transactions that have not posted during the qualification period do not qualify
biggest_catch: $100 per referral with a $500/year cap — but the reward only lands if your friend completes ALL qualifying activities, and you can't see their progress (confidential).
eligibility: First Financial Bank customers; referred friends open qualifying consumer or business checking accounts
timing: Paid once the referred individual completes all qualifying activities during the Program Period
